verdict.rationale: Elicit has alerts that notify users of new relevant papers automatically (elicit-docs-3, elicit-docs-15, elicit-docs-26), which is a limited form of background automation, but there's no evidence of general-purpose scheduled/autonomous agent workflows running independently of a user session. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled or triggerable autonomous agent runs beyond alerts, ability to configure multi-step automations, independent verification that alerts/automations run reliably in background.
